notes:
アニメ is short for ⟦アニメーション→アニメーション：noentry⟧ (animation), typically referring to Japanese animated works.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- アニメ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to watch anime
- アニメ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to adapt into anime
- アニメ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧: anime film
- ⟦{声優|せいゆう}→声優：12093_seiyuu⟧: voice actor (for anime)

RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧: manga (often adapted into anime)
- OVA (オーブイエー): original video animation
- ⟦{制作|せいさく}→制作：04320_seisaku⟧⟦{会社|がいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧: production company

CULTURAL NOTE:
Anime is a major part of Japanese pop culture and a significant export. In Japan, アニメ covers all animation, while overseas "anime" often specifically means Japanese animation.
